name: elm-lisp-interpreter
description: A lisp interpreter written in Elm

scripts.lint: elm-verify-examples && elm-format src/ tests/ --validate && elm-review && biome check
scripts.postinstall: rm -rf elm-stuff && ELM_HOME=$(pwd)/elm-home elm-janitor-apply-patches --all --noconsole || echo 'patching failed (non-critical)'
